WITRON is hiring a UI Developer to support its user interface team and maintain in-house legacy applications used in customer distribution centers. The role also contributes to upgrades, migrations, modernization, customer-requested changes, and technical documentation for intralogistics and automation systems.

Responsibilities
You maintain and extend mission-critical legacy applications in customer production environments
You support infrastructure upgrades, system migrations, and customer transitions while ensuring continued application stability
You contribute to modernization and migration initiatives
You collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to evaluate change requests, develop suitable solution approaches, prepare effort estimates, and implement and deploy agreed changes
You prepare clear technical documentation and specifications for end-user and developer audiences
You communicate effectively with customers and colleagues around the world
You develop technical solutions and recommendations with support from experienced team members, while coordinating with relevant stakeholders where required

Required
Experience with native Windows programming (preferably VB6)
Basic understanding of COM-based technologies and component-based application architectures
Experience working with SQL Databases (preferably Oracle)
Proficiency in Troubleshooting and Debugging issues, particularly in the Windows ecosystem
Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with both local and international colleagues and customers in English, across technical and non-technical contexts
Great attitude towards solving big problems and a “Can-Do” attitude
We value team players, practical experience, problem-solving ability, “Can do”-Attitude and a great personality
Experience should include project design, coding, testing, delivery and technical documentation of GitHub projects, or personal coding examples, class projects or previous professional assignments
Preferred
Bachelor's degree in computer science/engineering or equivalent experience combined with some educational experience is advantageous but not required
Helpful but not required: Experience with C#/.NET
Helpful but not required: Exposure to logistics industry / terminology
Helpful but not required: Exposure to large codebases
Logistics exposure is helpful but not required
